title: Preflight Evidence Bundle
description: The set of evidence items a producer submits to justify an Action Intent, plus an attestation over the bundle. The server-authoritative verifier validates schema, artifact hashes, provenance, freshness and internal consistency before any policy is evaluated. Producer-agnostic.

intentRef.description: Binds this bundle to a specific Action Intent. Every field must agree with the intent; a mismatch is a contradiction (fail-closed).

subjectHead.description: The intent's subject.head, restated here. Must equal intent.subject.head AND every evidence item's boundHead.

issuer.description: Who assembled and attested this bundle (the producer/adapter identity).

adapter.description: Adapter identifier, e.g. 'claude-code'. Establishes provenance: which producer this bundle came from.

evidence.description: One or more evidence items. An empty array is incomplete evidence (fail-closed for any policy requiring evidence).

type.description: Evidence class, e.g. 'tests-pass', 'stage1-clean', 'parity-clean', 'push-tier'. Policies require specific types.

producedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp the evidence was generated. Used for freshness. A future timestamp (after 'now') is contradictory.

boundHead.description: The commit SHA this evidence attests. Must equal intentRef.subjectHead; otherwise the evidence is about a different tree (contradiction).

artifact.description: The on-disk artifact backing the claim. The verifier recomputes sha256 of `path` and compares to `sha256`; a mismatch is forgery/tamper.

path.description: Path to the artifact, relative to the evidence root passed to the verifier.

sha256.description: Declared lowercase hex sha256 of the artifact bytes.

claims.description: Structured assertions carried by this evidence (e.g. {passed:true}). Free-form; policies may inspect known keys.

attestation.description: Integrity envelope over the bundle. bundleDigest is the canonical sha256 of the bundle with the attestation field removed. signature (optional) is an HMAC over bundleDigest under a key the producer does NOT hold; without it, integrity is 'unauthenticated' (a documented MVP boundary).

bundleDigest.description: Declared canonical sha256 over the bundle sans attestation. The verifier recomputes and compares; a mismatch is tamper.

signature.description: Optional lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over bundleDigest, verified only when the verifier is given --attestation-key. Defends against a forger who recomputes bundleDigest.
